description: List the 44 US lakes and reservoirs this server reads live (Lake Mead, Lake Powell, Lake Travis, Shasta, Oroville, Lanier, Texoma, Kentucky Lake and more) by name, river, operator or state. Returns each slug, full-pool elevation, the gauge agency and the lakelevelnow.com page. Call with no arguments to list them all.

query.description: Words from the lake, river or dam name, for example "travis" or "colorado river".

state.description: Two-letter state code (TX) or full state name (Texas).

name: search_lakes
title: Search US lakes and reservoirs
